gloss: staggered work hours; flexible commuting times

definitions.gloss: staggered work hours; commuting outside rush hour
definitions.explanation: a work arrangement where employees start and end work at non-standard times to avoid rush hour congestion

notes:
MODERN WORK TERM:
{時差出勤|じさしゅっきん} combines ⟦{時差|じさ}→時差：03075_jisa⟧ (time difference) + ⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ (going to work). It allows employees to avoid crowded trains.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ - early morning start (7:00-8:00)
- {遅|おそ}め⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ - later start (10:00-11:00)
- ⟦フレックス{制|せい}→フレックス制：08595_furekkususei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{併用|へいよう}→併用：11558_heiyou⟧ - combined with flextime

BENEFITS:
- ⟦{混雑|こんざつ}→混雑：02809_konzatsu⟧⟦{回避|かいひ}→回避：11810_kaihi⟧ - avoiding crowds
- {感染症対策|かんせんしょうたいさく} - disease prevention
- ⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦{軽減|けいげん}→軽減：16954_keigen⟧ - reduced commuting stress
- {生産性向上|せいさんせいこうじょう} - increased productivity

CULTURAL NOTE:
Particularly relevant in Japan where ⟦{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ→通勤ラッシュ：08486_tsuukinrasshu⟧ (commuter rush) is extremely crowded, especially in Tokyo and Osaka.
